metadata.question: Were there two isolated islands within a 2 km radius of (27.245974, 140.878144) on December 8, 2013, which had merged into a single island by March 30, 2014?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use Landsat 8/7 Collection 2 Level-2 SR near (27.245974, 140.878144).
- Target dates: 2013-12-08 and 2014-03-30. Expand windows progressively: ±0d, ±15d, ±30d, ±45d until images found.
- Prefer LC08; fallback to LE07 if needed. Use ROI = 2 km radius buffer.

2. Masking strategy.
- Mask clouds and shadows using QA_PIXEL bits (cloud: 3, shadow: 4).
- Scale SR bands (0.0000275, -0.2). Compute NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) and classify land as NDWI < 0.
- Vectorize land within ROI to count connected islands; filter small noise by area threshold (≥ 5000 m²).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error.
- If no images after all attempts: C1.
- If images exist but valid pixels (NDWI count at 1 km scale) == 0: C2.
- If any computed metric is null/NaN: C3.
- Else, if islands(T1) ≥ 2 and islands(T2) == 1: A; otherwise B.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((v, e) => {
      if (e) reject(e);
      else resolve(v);
    });
  });
}

function maskAndScaleL2(img) {
  var qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
  var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud
             .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // cloud shadow
  var scaled = img.select(img.bandNames().filter(ee.Filter.stringContains('item', 'SR_')))
                  .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
  return scaled.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
}

function addNdwi(img) {
  // Map green/nir band names for L8 vs L7
  var bnames = img.bandNames();
  var hasB3 = bnames.contains('SR_B3'); // L8
  var green = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasB3, img.select('SR_B3'), img.select('SR_B2'))).rename('green');
  var nir   = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasB3, img.select('SR_B5'), img.select('SR_B4'))).rename('nir');
  var ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI');
  return img.addBands(ndwi);
}

function buildCollection(sensor, roi, start, end) {
  var colId = sensor === 'LC08' ? 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2' : 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2';
  var col = ee.ImageCollection(colId)
              .filterBounds(roi)
              .filterDate(start, end)
              .map(maskAndScaleL2)
              .map(addNdwi);
  return col;
}

async function getCompositeForDate(targetDate, roi) {
  // Progressive windows (days)
  var windows = [0, 15, 30, 45];
  var chosen = null;
  var chosenMeta = null;

  for (var w of windows) {
    var start = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-w, 'day');
    var end = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(w + 1, 'day');
    // Try LC08 then LE07
    for (var sensor of ['LC08', 'LE07']) {
      var col = buildCollection(sensor, roi, start, end);
      var size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size > 0) {
        // Sort by CLOUD_COVER then make median composite to reduce SLC gaps, etc.
        var sorted = col.sort('CLOUD_COVER');
        var comp = sorted.median().set({
          'sensor': sensor,
          'win_days': w,
          'start': start.format('YYYY-MM-dd'),
          'end': end.format('YYYY-MM-dd'),
          'imgs': size
        });
        var meanCloud = await getInfoAsync(sorted.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER'));
        chosen = comp.set({'mean_cloud': meanCloud});
        chosenMeta = await getInfoAsync(comp.toDictionary(['sensor','win_days','start','end','imgs','mean_cloud']));
        return {image: chosen, meta: chosenMeta};
      }
    }
  }
  return {image: null, meta: null};
}

async function countIslands(ndwiImg, roi, minAreaM2) {
  // Valid pixel count at coarse scale (1 km) to detect C2
  var validCount = await getInfoAsync(
    ndwiImg.select('NDWI').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('NDWI')
  );
  if (!validCount) return {validCount: 0, landKm2: 0, islandCount: 0};

  // Land mask and vectorization at 30 m scale within small ROI
  var land = ndwiImg.select('NDWI').lt(0).selfMask(); // land = NDWI < 0
  var vectors = land.reduceToVectors({
    geometry: roi,
    scale: 30,
    maxPixels: 1e8,
    geometryType: 'polygon',
    eightConnected: true
  }).map(function(f){ return f.set('area', f.geometry().area()); })
    .filter(ee.Filter.gte('area', minAreaM2));

  var islandCount = await getInfoAsync(vectors.size());
  // Land area (approx, at 1000 m scale)
  var landArea = await getInfoAsync(
    land.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('pixelarea')
  );
  landArea = landArea || 0;
  var landKm2 = landArea / 1e6;

  return {validCount: validCount, landKm2: landKm2, islandCount: islandCount};
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var lon = 140.878144, lat = 27.245974;
    var pt = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]);
    var roi = pt.buffer(2000); // 2 km radius
    var t1 = '2013-12-08';
    var t2 = '2014-03-30';
    var minArea = 5000; // m^2 threshold to ignore tiny specks

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    var sel1 = await getCompositeForDate(t1, roi);
    var sel2 = await getCompositeForDate(t2, roi);

    if (!sel1.image || !sel2.image) {
      console.log(`T1 imgs: ${sel1.meta ? sel1.meta.imgs : 0} | T2 imgs: ${sel2.meta ? sel2.meta.imgs : 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    var ndwi1 = ee.Image(sel1.image).select('NDWI');
    var ndwi2 = ee.Image(sel2.image).select('NDWI');

    var stats1 = await countIslands(ee.Image(sel1.image), roi, minArea);
    var stats2 = await countIslands(ee.Image(sel2.image), roi, minArea);

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`T1 sel: ${sel1.meta.sensor}, win±${sel1.meta.win_days}d, imgs:${sel1.meta.imgs}, meanCloud:${(sel1.meta.mean_cloud||0).toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`T1 valid(1km): ${stats1.validCount}, land_km2: ${stats1.landKm2.toFixed(3)}, islands(>=${(minArea/1e4).toFixed(2)}ha): ${stats1.islandCount}`);
    console.log(`T2 sel: ${sel2.meta.sensor}, win±${sel2.meta.win_days}d, imgs:${sel2.meta.imgs}, meanCloud:${(sel2.meta.mean_cloud||0).toFixed(1)}%`);
    console.log(`T2 valid(1km): ${stats2.validCount}, land_km2: ${stats2.landKm2.toFixed(3)}, islands(>=${(minArea/1e4).toFixed(2)}ha): ${stats2.islandCount}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    // C2: No valid pixels after masking
    if (stats1.validCount === 0 || stats2.validCount === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    // C3: invalid results
    if ([stats1.islandCount, stats2.islandCount].some(v => v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v))) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Decision: two islands at T1 and one island at T2
    var answer = (stats1.islandCount >= 2 && stats2.islandCount === 1) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
